findings.requirement: Every styled component must have a `label` property for debugging. The label format is `ParentComponentName_StyledElementName` (spec section 'Emotion styled component conventions', lines 218-230)
findings.actual: The `platoNavLinkStyles` function (lines 429-468) produces CSS with no `label:` property. When this is applied to `PlatoNavItem` at line 470, the resulting styled component has no debugging label. By contrast, `PlatoNavLabel` (line 472) correctly includes `label: JobApplicationSidebar_PlatoNavLabel`. The `PlatoNavItem` styled component is missing its required `label: JobApplicationSidebar_PlatoNavItem` declaration.
findings.fix: Add `label: JobApplicationSidebar_PlatoNavItem;` as the first line inside the template literal returned by `platoNavLinkStyles`, immediately before `height: 40px;`.
